description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different categories in a dataset, showing the proportion of various task categories. The chart is divided into 7 slices, representing the categories Math, Coding, Information Seeking, Reasoning, Planning, Creative Writing, and Others (combined). The slices are colored red, blue, lime green, orange, periwinkle, pink, and light green, respectively. The proportions are labeled directly on the chart, with Math occupying approximately 29.3% of the chart, Coding taking up around 24.3%, Information Seeking comprising about 22.2%, Reasoning making up 10.4%, Others (combined) accounting for 9.3%, Planning representing 2.3%, and Creative Writing constituting 2.2%. A legend is provided to the top left, mapping the colors to their corresponding categories. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with the largest slice, Math, positioned at the top left, and the smallest slices, Planning and Creative Writing, placed near the top right.
